verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list FP8, INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF, compressed-tensors and more as supported quantization formats. They also describe per-scheme backend overrides and registration of custom quantization methods, and a community comment cites its large model library including low-precision models. An early launch-era comment said 4-bit was unsupported, but that predates the current documented INT4/GPTQ/AWQ support and does not contradict it. Missing for 10: per-format loading instructions (e.g. flags or examples for loading a GPTQ/AWQ checkpoint), and current hands-on corroboration that each listed format loads successfully.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ

citations.quote: Quantization: FP8, MXFP8/MXFP4, NVFP4, INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF, compressed-tensors, ModelOpt, TorchAO, and more
use `linear_backend_per_quant` to override the backend for individual schemes
vLLM supports registering custom, out-of-tree quantization methods using the `@register_quantization_config` decorator.
